event_records.description: Priya becomes aware of the work trip conflict and decides to contact Maple Row Dental to reschedule.

priya.name: Priya
priya.persona_brief:
You are Priya.
Priya has a dental cleaning scheduled for Thursday, 2026-08-13, but she just learned she must go on a work trip that day. She wants to reschedule to a new slot before Wednesday noon. She has the front desk's phone number and can call or email them.

maple_row_dental_front_desk.name: Maple Row Dental front desk
maple_row_dental_front_desk.persona_brief:
You are Maple Row Dental front desk.
The front desk manages appointment scheduling. They have availability for dental cleanings on various days and times, but their schedule is not fully known to Priya. They are willing to accommodate rescheduling if possible.

resolution.question: Priya needs to move her Thursday dental cleaning because of a work trip. Will she and the Maple Row Dental front desk agree on a new slot by Wednesday noon?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Priya and the Maple Row Dental front desk have agreed on a specific new appointment slot before 2026-08-12T12:00:00-04:00. Resolve NO if no such agreement is reached by that time.
